class: a hung test run that holds the pipeline and leaves its processes behind
caught_by: every tier runs in its own process group under bound_minutes. At the bound the group is killed and its survivors counted, and the tier is not-run (timeout), never a pass: on_timeout not-done finishes without it, and retry-2x retries once at twice the bound, after the tier's cleanup
missed_by: a timeout that killed only the direct child, so the test workers kept running: dozens of leaked processes sat behind a many-hour stall

cost.source: not yet measured; first real run
